description: This file contains unit tests for the ConfigStore component of a software project. It tests the loading and saving functionalities in both remote and local modes, using the testing framework and annotations specific to Swift. It also interacts with the ConfigStore's override mechanisms to simulate different modes and verify behavior.

classes.name: ConfigStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating the behavior of ConfigStore in different modes.

methods.name: load uses remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() uses remote data source when in remote mode.

methods.name: load uses local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load() uses local data source when in local mode.

methods.name: save routes to remote in remote mode
methods.description: Verifies that ConfigStore.save() sends data to remote storage in remote mode.

methods.name: save routes to local in local mode
methods.description: Verifies that ConfigStore.save() writes data locally in local mode.
